limitations: Initial fixtures preserve native fixed17 furniture-06 state with explicit injected expression rights, neutral expression/experience and sound off. They are not acquisition evidence.
Original24-01/02/03/04/05/06 failure reports remain unchanged. This union does not retrospectively mark them PASS.

The 25 tablet and first2 phone portrait images are actual UI screenshots from24-03. Transparent/cleared static toDataURL images are excluded. Remaining23 phone portraits use compositor canvas screenshots from24-04.

Old furniture poses are not universally usable. Real UI search, exact item placement and one nearby swing storage per relevant context enabled remaining uses. Original no-space and same-resident repair are retained.
Photo stores in these visual fixtures are empty; no populated-photo, acquisition, audio, performance, spontaneous home replay or interruption matrix claim.
Finite union establishes only listed observed rig/clothes/camera/native-result cases. Broad visual refinement, art parity, child understanding and full Goal stay open.
